basic_details.job_title: CSC District Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Five District Coordinator (जिला समन्वयक) posts, one each in Bemetara, Durg, Kanker, Korba and Rajnandgaon districts of Chhattisgarh, are open at CSC e-Governance Services India Limited. The last date to apply is 30 November 2026. Eligibility, application process, educational qualification and experience are in the Career Section of https://csc.gov.in.

qualification.details: Graduate in any discipline, Must have at least CCC level Certificate from NIELIT, or a minimum of a 6 month Diploma in Computer Science; At least 2 years of work experience preferably in IT/e-Governance/IT related project co-ordination and program Management in related fields. | Maximum Consultancy fee of Rs. 20,000 p.m. inclusive of all taxes and charges.

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications from eligible and interested candidates and directs them to the Career Section of the official CSC website, https://csc.gov.in, for eligibility, the application process, educational qualification, experience and other details. It asks candidates to complete the application process before the last date, 30 November 2026. The notice itself does not describe the application steps, the documents to attach or any form.

content_sections.heading: CSC District Coordinator at a Glance
content_sections.text: The notice does not specify the age limit, the pay, the application fee or the selection process. It also does not print the educational qualification or the experience required; these are to be seen in the Career Section of the CSC website.
